name: Sasha Alvart
original_name: サーシャ・アルバート
source: Young girl who hates people, especially men. Because of this she doesnt't try to make friends and actually doesn't have a single friend in the school. As an escapist, she loves nature and spends her days alone talking to animals and plants.
